title: Organization Node
description: A node in the organizational graph: a user, group, org-unit or service account, normalized across providers (Microsoft Graph, LDAP/AD, Cognito + HRIS). Carries the manager reference so the approval capability can resolve approval chains. Provider-neutral by design; the native id lives under source.external_id.

manager_id.description: ReBAC 'manager_of' edge source; null at the top of the chain.

external_id.description: Native id in the source system.
